```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

# Load / pre-process GWAS Catalog data

```{r load_gwas}
# Load GWAS Catalog studies
# gwas_study_info <- fread(here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas-catalog-v1.0.3.1-studies-r2025-07-21.tsv"),
#                          sep = "\t", quote = "")

gwas_study_info <- fread(here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas-catalog-v1.0.3.1-studies-r2026-09-13.tsv"),
                         sep = "\t", 
                         quote = "")

# Standardize column names (remove spaces)
gwas_study_info <- gwas_study_info |>
  rename_all(~gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_study_info <- gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, " \\| ", "|")) |>
mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, "\\| ", "|")) |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, " \\|", "|"))

# some use commas instead of | to designate multiple cohorts
gwas_study_info <- gwas_study_info |>
    mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, ", ", "|"))

# choose only selected disease papers
selected_papers <-
  data.table::fread(here::here("output/icd_map/gwas_study_gbd_causes.csv")) |>
  filter(include == TRUE) |>
  pull(PUBMED_ID) |>
  unique()

length(selected_papers)

gwas_study_info <- 
  gwas_study_info |>
  filter(PUBMED_ID %in% selected_papers) |>
  distinct()

gwas_study_info <-
  gwas_study_info |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, COHORT, DATE, STUDY)

```

### Remove uninformative labels

```{r remove_uninformative_cohort_names}

# making "multiple" designation to be the same
gwas_study_info <- gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, 
                                   "(\\(Multiple cohorts\\))|(\\(multiple\\))|Multiple",
                                  "multiple")) 


# number of cohorts listed as 'multiple'
gwas_study_info |> 
  filter(grepl("multiple", COHORT, ignore.case = T)) |> 
  group_by(COHORT) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

# remove cohorts listed as multiple
gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "multiple",
                                          string = COHORT)
         )

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "multiple",
                                          string = COHORT)
         )


# making others be the same  
gwas_study_info <- gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, "Other", "other")) |> 
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, "OTHER", "other")) |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_replace_all(COHORT, "others", "other")) 

# number of cohorts listed as other
gwas_study_info |> 
  filter(grepl("other", COHORT)) |> 
  group_by(COHORT) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head()

gwas_study_info |>
  filter(grepl("other", COHORT)) |> 
  nrow()

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "(^other$)|(^other\\|)|(\\|other$)",
                                          string = COHORT)
         ) |>
  mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_replace_all(pattern = "\\|other\\|",
                                          string = COHORT,
                                          replacement = "|")
         )

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "other",
                                          string = COHORT)
         )

# not reported: 
gwas_study_info |> 
  filter(grepl("NR", COHORT)) |> 
  group_by(COHORT) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head()


gwas_study_info |> 
  filter(grepl("NR", COHORT)) |>
  nrow()

gwas_study_info = 
gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_remove_all(pattern ="(^NR$)|(^NR\\|)|(\\|NR$)", 
                                                 string = COHORT)) |>
    mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_replace_all(pattern = "(\\|NR\\|)",
                                          string = COHORT,
                                          replacement = "|")
         )

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  mutate(COHORT = str_remove_all(pattern = "\\|$",
                                 string = COHORT))



```


### Fixing some discrepancies with multiple cohorts 

```{r fix_multiple_cohorts}

gwas_study_info |>
    filter(grepl("\\band\\b", COHORT)) |>
    distinct(COHORT)
  
  
gwas_study_info <- 
        gwas_study_info |>
        mutate(COHORT = ifelse(COHORT == "CanSCAD cases and MGI controls",
                               "CanSCAD|MGI", 
                               COHORT)) 

gwas_study_info <- 
        gwas_study_info |>
        mutate(COHORT = stringr::str_replace_all(
                                string = COHORT,
                                pattern = "(?:(?<=^)|(?<=\\|))ROS(?=$|\\|)|(?:(?<=^)|(?<=\\|))MAP(?=$|\\|)",
                               replacement = "ROSMAP"
                               )
        )

```

# Load / prepare list of GWAS Cohort Names 

Full list of abbreviations downloaded from: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/docs/fileheaders#_file_headers_for_unpublished_studies (https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/spot/pgs/metadata/pgs_all_metadata_cohorts.csv).

```{r load_gwas_cohort_names}

# listing cohort names
gwas_cohort_names <- data.table::fread("data/gwas_catalog/pgs_all_metadata_cohorts.csv")

gwas_cohort_names <- 
  gwas_cohort_names |> 
  rename_all(~gsub(" ", "_", .x))

```

## Making cohort names unique

And multiple rows per alternative name or synonym or abbreviation for a cohort.

```{r make_cohort_names_unique}

gwas_cohort_names <- 
  gwas_cohort_names |> 
  mutate(`Previous/other/additional_names` = 
           stringr::str_replace_all(`Previous/other/additional_names`, 
                                    "chances of preventing, recognizing early and optimally treating",
                                    "chances of preventing* recognizing early and optimally treating"
           )
  ) |>
    mutate(`Previous/other/additional_names` = 
           stringr::str_replace_all(`Previous/other/additional_names`, 
                                    "on Nephropathy, of relevance to public health, which is Chronic, possibly in its Initial stages, and",
                                    "on Nephropathy* of relevance to public health* which is Chronic* possibly in its Initial stages* and"
           )
  ) |>
  mutate(`Previous/other/additional_names` = 
           stringr::str_replace_all(`Previous/other/additional_names`, 
                                    ";",
                                    ",")
  )

gwas_cohort_names <-
gwas_cohort_names |>
  group_by(Cohort_Name) |>
  mutate(`Previous/other/additional_names` = ifelse(`Previous/other/additional_names` == "",
                                                    NA_character_,
                                                    `Previous/other/additional_names`)) |>
  tidyr::unite("other_names", 
               c(Cohort_ID, `Previous/other/additional_names`), 
               sep = ", ", 
               na.rm = TRUE) |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(other_names, 
                          delim = ", ") 


gwas_cohort_names |> 
  filter(grepl("GENESTAR", 
               other_names, 
               ignore.case = T))

gwas_cohort_names <-
  gwas_cohort_names |>
  mutate(other_names = ifelse(other_names == "GeneSTAR_b",
                            "GeneSTAR",
                            other_names))

gwas_cohort_names |> 
  filter(grepl("AtheroRemo", Cohort_Name))

gwas_cohort_names |> 
  filter(grepl("Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg", Cohort_Name))

gwas_cohort_names |> 
  filter(other_names == "HCHS" | other_names == "SOL")

gwas_cohort_names |>
  filter(other_names == "CCGB_2")

gwas_cohort_names <-
gwas_cohort_names |>
  mutate(Cohort_Name = case_when(
    grepl("AtheroRemo", Cohort_Name) ~ "AtheroRemo",
    grepl("Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg", Cohort_Name) ~ "Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg",
    other_names == "HCHS" | other_names == "SOL" ~ "Hispanic Community Health Study / Study of Latinos",
    other_names == "CCGB_2" ~ "Cleveland Clinic GeneBank Study",
    TRUE ~ Cohort_Name
  )) |>
  distinct()

gwas_cohort_names  |>
  group_by(other_names) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 1)


non_unique_cohort_names = 
gwas_cohort_names  |>
  group_by(other_names) |>
  summarise(n = n())  |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  pull(other_names) 

gwas_cohort_names <-
  gwas_cohort_names |>
  mutate(non_unique_id = ifelse(other_names %in% non_unique_cohort_names, 
                                TRUE,
                                FALSE)
         ) |>
  rename(Cohort_ID = other_names)

```

## Checking: Any fuzzy names to check? 

```{r fuzzy_names_check}

library(stringdist)
library(dplyr)

# Identify pairs with small distance (e.g., <=2 edits)
small_dist_pairs <- function(threshold, 
                             dist_matrix_method,
                             all_cohorts) {
  
  # Create a vector of unique cohort names
  cohorts <- unique(all_cohorts)
  
  single_use_cohorts  =   data.frame(cohort = all_cohorts) |>
                          group_by(cohort) |>
                          summarise(n_studies = n()) |>
                          filter(n_studies == 1) |>
                          pull(cohort)
  
  # Compute pairwise string distances (Levenshtein distance)
  dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(single_use_cohorts, 
                                  cohorts, 
                                  method = dist_matrix_method)
  
  matches <- which(dist_matrix > 0 & dist_matrix <= threshold, 
                   arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  matches <- data.frame(
    cohort1 = single_use_cohorts[matches[,1]],
    cohort2 = cohorts[matches[,2]],
    distance = dist_matrix[matches]
  )
  
  matches <- matches[matches$cohort1 != matches$cohort2, ]
  matches <- unique(matches)
  
  return(matches)
  
}

small_dist_pairs(threshold = 2, 
                 dist_matrix_method = "lv",
                 all_cohorts = all_cohorts) |>
  arrange(distance) |>
  head()

small_dist_pairs(threshold = 2,
                 dist_matrix_method = "lcs",
                 all_cohorts = all_cohorts) |>
  arrange(distance) |>
  head()
```

# Any cohorts missing from data-dictionary?

```{r any_cohorts_missing_from_dict}

gwas_study_info <-
left_join(
gwas_study_info |>
rename(Cohort_ID = COHORT),
gwas_cohort_names,
by = "Cohort_ID")

gwas_study_info  <-
  gwas_study_info  |>
  mutate(Cohort_ID = ifelse(Cohort_ID == "",
                            NA_character_,
                            Cohort_ID))


normalise_cohort_names <- function(Cohort_Name_Col){
  
  normalised_names <-
  stringr::str_squish(Cohort_Name_Col) |>
  stringr::str_to_title() |> 
                       stringr::str_replace_all(pattern = "\u00A0", 
                                                replacement = " ") |>
                       stringr::str_remove_all("[®™]") |>
                       stringr::str_remove_all("^The\\s+") |>
                       stringr::str_remove_all("\\s+Study(?=(\\s+|$))")
  
  return(normalised_names)

}

gwas_study_info  <-
  gwas_study_info  |>
  mutate(Cohort = normalise_cohort_names(Cohort_Name))
                       

cohort_names_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/cohort/cohort_desc_v3_sep17.xlsx")) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), 
                ~stringr::str_replace_all(.x,
                                          pattern = "\u00A0",
                                          replacement = " "))) 

cohort_names_df  <-
  cohort_names_df  |>
  mutate(full_name = ifelse(full_name == "" | is.na(full_name),
                            short_name,
                            full_name)) |>
  mutate(full_name = stringr::str_squish(full_name)) |>
  filter(full_name != "")

  
cohort_names_df <-
  cohort_names_df |>
  group_by(full_name) |>
  mutate(synonyms = stringr::str_flatten(
                        unique(c(synonyms, short_name, full_name)), 
                         collapse = "; ",
                        na.rm = T)) |>
  ungroup()

cohort_names_df  <-
cohort_names_df |>
  distinct(full_name, cohort_group, synonyms) |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(synonyms, 
                          delim = "; ") |>
    mutate(synonyms = normalise_cohort_names(synonyms)) |>
  rename(Cohort = synonyms)

anti_join(
  gwas_study_info |>
    distinct(Cohort_ID, Cohort_Name, Cohort),
  cohort_names_df
)

# all cohort names:
```

```{r saving}

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  select(PUBMED_ID,
         DATE,
         COHORT = Cohort_ID) |>
  distinct()

gwas_study_info =
  gwas_study_info |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(COHORT, sep = "\\|") |>
  # mutate(COHORT = ifelse(COHORT != "",

  #                        #                  pattern = "\\|")
  #                               # ),
  #                        "")

  group_by(PUBMED_ID) |>
  summarise(COHORT = str_flatten(unique(COHORT),
```
